description: Stage 11 admin evaluation scenarios. Each is implemented and executed by scripts/evaluate_admin.py against a fresh in-process API (temporary SQLite database seeded from data/faqs.json, deterministic stand-in embedding model, LLM off). Actual results are written by the run, never by hand.

scenarios.description: An admin creates a new FAQ.
scenarios.action: POST /admin/faqs with a valid FAQ, then search for it publicly.
scenarios.expected: 201 with the next faq_NNN ID and version 1; the public keyword search finds it.

scenarios.description: The same question is submitted twice (double click).
scenarios.action: POST the same question again, differently capitalised.
scenarios.expected: 409 FAQ_DUPLICATE_QUESTION; still one FAQ.

scenarios.description: An FAQ with an empty answer.
scenarios.action: POST /admin/faqs with answer "".
scenarios.expected: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the field, without echoing values; nothing stored.

scenarios.description: An answer longer than 5,000 characters.
scenarios.action: POST /admin/faqs with a 5,001-character answer.
scenarios.expected: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; nothing stored.

scenarios.description: An unknown category.
scenarios.action: POST /admin/faqs with category "pets".
scenarios.expected: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; nothing stored.

scenarios.description: An admin edits an answer.
scenarios.action: PATCH faq_001 answer with expected_version 1; ask the chatbot its exact question.
scenarios.expected: Version 2; the public FAQ and the chatbot's answer are the new text.

scenarios.description: Two admins edit the same version.
scenarios.action: Two PATCHes, both with expected_version 1.
scenarios.expected: First saved (version 2); second 409 FAQ_VERSION_CONFLICT; the first text is kept.

scenarios.description: An admin deactivates an FAQ.
scenarios.action: POST /deactivate; fetch it publicly; ask its exact question.
scenarios.expected: Public 404; the chatbot does not cite faq_001; the FAQ is still stored.

scenarios.description: A deactivated FAQ is activated again.
scenarios.action: POST /activate; ask its exact question.
scenarios.expected: Public 200; the chatbot answers with faq_001 again.

scenarios.description: An FAQ moves to another category.
scenarios.action: PATCH category to shipping.
scenarios.expected: Listed under shipping, not orders; the revision records only the category change.

scenarios.description: New tags make an FAQ findable by keyword.
scenarios.action: PATCH faq_001 keywords to include "zeppelin"; keyword search "zeppelin".
scenarios.expected: Before: no result. After: faq_001 found, without a restart.

scenarios.description: A question edit re-embeds only that question.
scenarios.action: PATCH faq_001's question; search semantically.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one FAQ question embedded; the index revision matches the catalogue; the new question is indexed.

scenarios.description: An FAQ is deactivated while a chat request is retrieving.
scenarios.action: Deactivate faq_001 from inside the request (encoder hook); ask its exact question.
scenarios.expected: The reply does not cite faq_001.

scenarios.description: An answer is edited while a chat request is retrieving.
scenarios.action: Edit the answer from inside the request; ask its exact question.
scenarios.expected: The reply is the new answer, never a mix of versions.

scenarios.description: The embedding model fails after a question edit.
scenarios.preconditions: Index built; the model then fails.
scenarios.action: Edit faq_001's question; search.
scenarios.expected: The stale index is never served (EmbeddingError); decisions fall back to keyword-only over current FAQs.

scenarios.description: A committed change cannot be read back into memory.
scenarios.action: Deactivate faq_001; chat; chat again once reloads work.
scenarios.expected: First chat 503 (help articles unavailable), never an answer from the old catalogue; then answers without faq_001.

scenarios.description: The database refuses a write.
scenarios.action: POST /admin/faqs.
scenarios.expected: 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE without internal details; nothing stored; catalogue revision unchanged.

scenarios.description: FAQ changes without admin rights.
scenarios.action: PATCH faq_001 with no token, a customer token, and a support token.
scenarios.expected: 401, 401, 403 STAFF_FORBIDDEN; faq_001 unchanged.

scenarios.description: No staff configured on the server.
scenarios.action: GET /admin/faqs and /support/tickets with a well-formed token.
scenarios.expected: 403 STAFF_ACCESS_DISABLED for both.

scenarios.description: History of a created, edited and deactivated FAQ.
scenarios.action: Create, edit the answer, deactivate; GET revisions.
scenarios.expected: Three revisions newest first: deactivated, updated (answer only), created; changed_by is the admin.

scenarios.description: Support staff review a customer's request.
scenarios.action: Support token: list tickets, open it.
scenarios.expected: Listed without contact details; the detail has the description and contact details.

scenarios.description: A ticket is assigned and moved to in progress.
scenarios.action: Assign to a configured staff member; change status to in_progress.
scenarios.expected: Status in_progress, assignee set; both changes in the event history with the staff ID.

scenarios.description: Resolving an open ticket directly.
scenarios.action: PATCH status resolved.
scenarios.expected: 409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION; status still open; no event.

scenarios.description: Assigning to someone who is not staff, then reassigning.
scenarios.action: Assign to "intruder"; assign to maria; reassign to sam.
scenarios.expected: 422 for intruder; then an assignment_changed event maria -> sam.

scenarios.description: Counts match what happened.
scenarios.action: 3 chats (one answered by exact question) and 2 tickets; GET analytics/chat and analytics/tickets for today.
scenarios.expected: 3 customer messages, 3 chatbot responses, answered >= 1, decisions sum to 3; 2 tickets created; rates null (fewer than 30 responses).

scenarios.description: Analytics with no data.
scenarios.action: GET dashboard summary, analytics/chat, analytics/tickets.
scenarios.expected: Zeros everywhere; every rate null with a note; no division error.

scenarios.description: Changes and refusals are audited.
scenarios.action: Admin edits faq_001; support tries to edit it; read the audit log.
scenarios.expected: faq.updated by the admin (success) and auth.access_denied by the support member (denied); no tokens in the log.

scenarios.description: A server started with an empty FAQ seed file.
scenarios.action: GET /ready, then ask a question.
scenarios.expected: knowledge_base unavailable; the chatbot answers with the no-match message (no crash).
